brand.name: Kalidass Travels
brand.tagline: Executive Chauffeur & Outstation Mobility Across South India
brand.designStandard: Google Material Design 3 (M3) Executive Midnight Charcoal & Onyx
brand.rule2Notice: Signature Logo Red is strictly reserved for the 'K' monogram mark. NEVER use red for tariffs, rates, prices, or live status indicators.

primary.name: Executive Midnight Charcoal
primary.usage: Primary brand anchor, desktop headers, primary CTA buttons, premium poster borders, high-contrast dark backgrounds.

onPrimary.name: Pure Crisp White
onPrimary.usage: High-contrast text on Midnight Charcoal surfaces, default poster base for daylight promotional flyers.

brandRed.name: Signature Logo 'K' Red
brandRed.usage: STRICTLY RESTRICTED to the 'K' logo emblem mark. NEVER use for fares, pricing, buttons, or promotional starbursts.

ratesOnyx.name: Deep Midnight Onyx Slate
ratesOnyx.usage: MANDATORY for all rates, fares, per-km numbers, headlines, and primary typography. Generates maximum consumer trust.

tertiaryAmber.name: Warm Saffron Golden Amber
tertiaryAmber.usage: 5-star Google review rating stars, temple tour headers (Tirupati, Chidambaram), VIP pilgrimage accent ribbons.

tertiaryContainer.name: Warm Champagne Container
tertiaryContainer.usage: Background container for rating badges, temple pilgrimage highlights, customer testimonials.

conversionGreen.name: Verified WhatsApp Green
conversionGreen.usage: Direct booking CTAs, WhatsApp QR code badge, 'Instant Dispatch' contact highlight.
conversionGreen.wcagOnWhite: 1.98:1 (Use with dark text or as filled button with dark/white icon)

surfaceCanvas.name: Anti-Glare Canvas Base
surfaceCanvas.usage: Web canvas backdrop, printed coupon cards, calm anti-glare flyer sectioning.

surfaceContainerLow.name: Soft Slate Container Low
surfaceContainerLow.usage: Alternating poster sections, vehicle capacity feature boxes, itemized receipt breakdown background.

outline.name: Accessible Stroke Outline
outline.usage: Form inputs, accessible component boundaries (4.8:1 WCAG Non-Text Contrast).

outlineVariant.name: Subtle Slate Divider Stroke
outlineVariant.usage: Card borders, divider lines, coupon cut lines, table separators.

textMuted.name: Muted Slate Secondary Text
textMuted.usage: Secondary subtitles, baggage/pax specs, disclaimer fine print, route km distances.

posterFormulas.title: Chennai Airport Taxi & City Flyer
posterFormulas.rule60: Pure White #FFFFFF canvas with subtle #F3F4F6 card containers
posterFormulas.rule30: Midnight Onyx #111827 headlines, vehicle outline, and clear flat tariffs (e.g., ₹600 Flat Sedan)
posterFormulas.rule10: WhatsApp Green #25D366 booking QR + Red #EC221F 'K' logo monogram
posterFormulas.targetMedia: A4 / A5 Handheld Flyer, Counter Standee, Newspaper Insert

posterFormulas.title: Tirupati / Pilgrimage Tour Poster
posterFormulas.rule60: Clean #F9FAFB background with #FEF3C7 warm champagne package header
posterFormulas.rule30: Midnight Charcoal #1E252D route steps, vehicle options, and inclusive pricing
posterFormulas.rule10: Golden Amber #D97706 temple star badge + Red #EC221F 'K' logo mark
posterFormulas.targetMedia: Travel Agency Standee, Hotel Lobby Banner, WhatsApp Status Card

posterFormulas.title: Corporate & Luxury Chauffeur Billboard
posterFormulas.rule60: Rich Black Midnight Charcoal (#111827 / #1E252D with C:60 M:40 Y:40 K:100)
posterFormulas.rule30: Crisp White #FFFFFF headline typography and metallic car cutouts (Innova Crysta, Urbania)
posterFormulas.rule10: Golden Amber #D97706 '5-Star Rated Chauffeurs' badge + WhatsApp Green helpline
posterFormulas.targetMedia: 10x20 ft Roadside Hoarding, 3x6 ft Roll-up Standee, Instagram Ad (1:1)

posterFormulas.title: Airport Arrivals Paging Placard
posterFormulas.rule60: Opaque Pure White #FFFFFF heavy 350 GSM card stock
posterFormulas.rule30: Massive 72pt Bold Midnight Onyx #111827 Guest Name
posterFormulas.rule10: Top-right 30mm 'K' Logo Red #EC221F + Bottom Kalidass Travels hotline in #1E252D
posterFormulas.targetMedia: MAA Airport Terminal Meet & Greet Chauffeur Signboard (A3 Laminated)

printStandards.bleed: 3 mm (0.125 inches) on all four edges
printStandards.safeMargin: 5 mm (0.2 inches) inside the cut line
printStandards.richBlackFormula: C: 60%, M: 40%, Y: 40%, K: 100% (Use for solid dark backgrounds)
printStandards.textBlackFormula: C: 0%, M: 0%, Y: 0%, K: 100% (Use for body text under 24pt)
